about: Method settings the human has ruled on. A flag, weight, score, shortlist or level may be a DEFAULT in code only if it has an entry here with a DECISIONS.md date and the human's words. Only the lead may edit this file, and only with a quote (methodology audit 2026-10-23, recommendation 8; human decision 8 and 10, 2026-10-25). tests/test_approved_methods.py pins the code to the 'pins' block. No Line 6 ids belong here.

methods.setting: AFx-Rep (embed_afxrep) shortlists models when there is no dry track
methods.decisions_entry: 2026-10-18 (human): go ahead on the five post-v4 recommendations, item 5
methods.context: The lead's item 5: AFx-Rep is used only to shortlist models and families when there is no dry track; knobs are not set by a sound-comparison score.
methods.approved_value: shortlist only (--shortlist afxrep, n=8 in song_match)

methods.setting: AFx-Rep distance orders the final models for song matches
methods.decisions_entry: 2026-10-25 (human): "yes go" to the lead's post-assessment plan, item 1
methods.context: Bundle approval, so provisional. Interim default pending the blind AFx-Rep validation (item 2, T223).
Bundle approval, so provisional. An option, not the default; Output/Master locked when used.
methods.approved_value: off by default (song_match --finetune); when on, Output/Master locked

methods.setting: Default level of the rebuilt dry track when no profile level exists
methods.context: Bundle approval, so provisional. The profile warns when a take disagrees by more than 3 dB; the level-only ablation runs inside T224.

methods.setting: The provisional no-DI loss (ltas_tilt, crest_flatness_hnr, envelope plus level guard) as a default ranking
methods.context: Bundle approval, so provisional. Removed as a default (T226). It can still be requested by name as a test setting.

methods.setting: Drive-family prior (family expansion of the shortlist, second-choice family)
methods.context: Bundle approval, so provisional. Removed as a default (T226); opt-in via --families.

methods.setting: Fixed slot order for chain prediction: drive, amp, cab, mod, delay, reverb, EQ, every slot optional
methods.decisions_entry: 2026-10-22 (human): use the fixed slot order for chain prediction
methods.quote: let's use the fixed slot order.
methods.context: Other plan decisions (shortlist per slot, backing-track source, bars, gate renumbering) stayed open.

pins.pin_notes: search_flags lists every flag song_match passes to match_block. Adding one needs an entry in 'methods' first. --knob-tol 0.15, --pack-lufs and --wall-min are pre-10-18 plumbing carried from T176/T200 and are NOT yet itemised in 'methods'; the audit lists them as unapproved test settings. They are pinned here as-is so the test passes today and any change shows up.
